explanation: The release gate failed because the requested centering correction was smaller than the motion routine's 0.003 m early-return tolerance. At frame 234, the measured radial extent plus current uncertainty was 0.04871535 m, exceeding the conservative usable radius of 0.0480066 m, while the package center was only about 0.00175 m from the bowl center. The second correction therefore produced no motion and repeated the same failed measurement. Preserve the release clearance criterion, saved geometry, tracker reference, and measured retention. Derive a tighter local pose tolerance from the radial margin available after recentering, execute a bounded reviewed correction, and reassess the actual object geometry after each lease rather than requiring exact pose convergence. Permit at most three corrections, log the numerical margins, and stop explicitly if the controller deadband prevents further evidence-producing progress. Release and post-release relation/stability checks remain required.
interface: The assembled method retains main(api), returning JSON-compatible completion_proposed and evidence. No new API operations or review fields are introduced. Existing episode checkpoints and tracker handles are reused with fresh observations; historical geometry is not treated as a current detection. Internal lease and move helpers gain an optional position_tolerance, defaulting to the existing 0.003 m. move also gains assess_effect, which returns after one reviewed local lease or view action so its caller can measure the object effect. Release alignment uses a tolerance clamped to the documented 0.0005..0.003 m range, derived from measured centered footprint radius, current registration uncertainty, and the existing conservative opening radius. It performs at most three corrections, rechecks retention and placement after motion, and preserves an already acceptable release height. Stalls remain explicit stops. A successful geometric gate only authorizes release; acknowledged opening, retreat, actual interior placement, and measured post-release stability are still separate requirements.
jev_protocol: Existing Jev questions and dispatch are preserved. Each world translation and rotation question explicitly selects its own processed_features.axes.<axis>.goal_relation: increase means positive, decrease means negative, and within_tolerance means hold. The gripper question follows objective.gripper using exactly open, close, or keep. api.drive still invokes real api.control decisions, with unchanged Jev choices and numerically bounded magnitudes. Alignment requests keep the jaws unchanged and use pad_center targets, the saved xyzw orientation, and the newly computed local tolerance. Python computes footprint radii, uncertainty margins, targets, and acceptance criteria; Jev is not asked to calculate them or infer hidden contact. Existing structured image reviews distinguish an observed external obstacle, no observed external obstacle, self-occlusion, and unobserved space before a local action. A reached pose, a track, or jaw delivery alone never establishes placement or task completion.
